---
title: "Logistic Regression baseline"
format: html
---

A simple, explainable baseline to compare against XGBoost (`final_submission.R`).
Same preprocessing: every predictor is a factor, missing answers get their own
"Missing" level, then one-hot encoding. Scored with 5-fold cross-validated ROC AUC.

# Libraries and data
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

set.seed(345)
train_raw <- read_csv("train.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Preprocessing
```{r}
y <- train_raw$overqualified

x <- train_raw %>%
  select(-id, -overqualified) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ fct_na_value_to_level(as.factor(.x), level = "Missing")))

# One-hot encode once on the full set so every fold has the same columns
X <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = x))
dim(X)
```

# 5-fold cross-validated AUC
```{r}
#| warning: false
folds <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = nrow(X)))

fold_auc <- map_dbl(1:5, function(k) {
  fit <- glm(y ~ ., data = cbind(y = y, X)[folds != k, ], family = binomial)
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = X[folds == k, ], type = "response")
  as.numeric(auc(roc(y[folds == k], pred, quiet = TRUE)))
})

fold_auc
mean(fold_auc)
```

# Full model: strongest effects
```{r}
#| warning: false
log_fit <- glm(y ~ ., data = cbind(y = y, X), family = binomial)

broom::tidy(log_fit) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)", !is.na(estimate)) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  head(15)
```
